name: Example: two branches, one report
description: Two searches run side by side: splunkd errors by component and warnings by host, both for yesterday. A Results of earlier steps step then works on the rows of both and builds one table.

steps.name: Errors by component
steps.spl:
index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd log_level=ERROR
| stats count AS errors BY component

steps.name: Warnings by host
steps.spl:
index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd log_level=WARN
| stats count AS warnings BY host

steps.name: Merge both
steps.spl:
| eval kind=if(isnotnull(errors), "errors", "warnings"), name=coalesce(component, host), count=coalesce(errors, warnings)
| table kind name count
| sort kind - count
